latin: In actibus nostri intellectus non est successio ratione potentiarum sensitiuarum et deseruientium, ut credunt moderni, sed eo: quia rationalis est.
translation: In the acts of our intellect there is no succession by reason of the sensitive and subordinate powers, as the moderns believe, but for this reason: because it is rational.
